verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has a public GitHub repository, and its docs explicitly name a "TruffleHog Open Source" edition. A community comment states v3 is licensed under AGPL (GPL before that), and another commenter reviewed the codebase directly, which confirms the source is readable. missing for 10: first-party license documentation (the AGPL claim comes only from a community comment), and evidence that Enterprise-only features such as SSO and RBAC are also open source.
